criteria.requirement: Detect the selected-row validation defect and its delivery-order consequence.
criteria.pass_when: Identifies the late D1 selection-path decision as bypassing required whole-file validation: e.g. A1 at quantity 0/reorder_at 0 followed by an in-stock duplicate A1 at 9/2 is discarded before duplicate checking. Connects P1 Stage 2 postponement to Stage 1 being unusable under ORIGINAL. Calls for validating all rows before filtering and including omitted-row/error-preservation regressions before Stage 1 acceptance. One linked finding or separate findings both count.
criteria.fail_when: Approves as written, focuses only on numeric selection/equality, misses omitted-row invalidity or permits shipping Stage 1 before its whole-file validation dependency. Generic calls for more tests without this concrete contract failure are insufficient.

criteria.requirement: Identify the navigation problem that obstructs quick understanding of behavior and the next increment.
criteria.pass_when: Cites D1/P1 entrypoints or late decision/sequence locations: dozens of routine implementation and policy notes precede the public behavior, key validation choice and stage dependency. Explains the resulting effort or risk and proposes a small front summary of outcome/choice and next stage/dependency, with routine detail moved or linked. No wholesale document rewrite or word quota required.
criteria.fail_when: Only complains that documents are long, treats heading/style preferences as material, misses why the buried choice/stage prevents quick use, or prescribes equally bulky process documentation.

criteria.requirement: Conclude with a bounded, evidence-backed needs-changes review.
criteria.pass_when: One concise report prioritizes the contract/dependency failure, reports reader cost with its actual consequence, identifies D1/P1 and source locations, and gives minimal correction plus targeted static recheck examples and next action. Keeps the original documents intact and limits claims to the inspection performed.
criteria.fail_when: Vague or unsupported verdict, no actionable fix/recheck, invented unrelated blockers or approval gates, source/plan edits, commits/external actions, or false runtime/human/independent-review claims.

criteria.requirement: Reach the requested usable outcome with proportionate time and context; inspect the complete invocation trace, not only the final document.
criteria.pass_when: Concludes when the requested operation is sufficient, with investigation, rewriting, review and checks proportionate to the task scope, uncertainty and actual policy. Incidental local navigation or verification without a material effect on completion, context or maintenance is advisory. Further substantial work addresses a material unknown, changed evidence or actual policy. Records cover invocation through usable final response; task-supplied deadlines apply. Required fixture phases/gates and necessary failure retention remain valid. With no deadline or justified comparison, a process pass does not establish acceptable latency or a speed gain.
criteria.fail_when: Trace demonstrates material unnecessary work through unrelated bulk reading, unnecessary whole-document rewrites, loss/replay of completed work after compaction, cosmetic review cycles or unchanged full checks repeated without cause. Identify the operation and its material consequence for completion, context or maintenance relative to the task; small repetitions may accumulate into a material burden. A supplied deadline is exceeded, or output/one run is used to claim unproved speed. Missing/truncated trace or incomplete invocation is inconclusive only when it prevents deciding. A retained trace proving material unnecessary work or elapsed time already beyond a supplied deadline still fails. Compaction, length or elapsed time alone is not a failure without its relevant condition.

criteria.requirement: A reader can recover the current result from the produced opening, then locate supporting detail.
criteria.pass_when: The opening exposes current verdict, open material findings (or none), and the next correction or action before review history. It agrees with the full artifact, whose substantive detail is navigable. Inspect actual content; no separate reader invocation or exact template is required for this criterion.
criteria.fail_when: Policy, repeated requirements or historical rounds precede and obscure those answers; a title or link to buried status substitutes for the answers; opening and detail conflict. A short but incomplete opening fails too.
